master_kill_switch.name: AVSHUNTER_DYNAMIC_RELEASE_DISABLE_ALL
master_kill_switch.effect: Disables every DDD runtime capability before the next invocation without granting legacy or AUTO authority.

database_restore.reason: This slice performs no schema migration. Append-only live-cycle observations are evidence and must not be erased unless corruption is proven.

rollback_triggers: runtime profile hash or contract validation failure
normal --evening resolves to anything other than BUILD_THESIS
direction or selected-contract identity changes in a downstream resolver
Morning actionable row lacks exact validation lineage
Execution Gate and Intelligence Lab authority mismatch
Interpreter reconciliation or ledger population invariant fails
verification_after_rollback: compare restored file hashes with backup MANIFEST.json
